response.sql: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL THEN a.g_1b - a.g_cf END), 0) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM player_totals) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(t.total - o.avg_total) AS average_excess FROM player_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.total > o.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: “Average total” means the average across all matched players. A player with no appearance row containing both values has a total of zero.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare each player's total with the average for players sharing their death country, including blank death countries.
alternatives.sql: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL THEN a.g_1b - a.g_cf END), 0) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), compared AS (SELECT total, AVG(total) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS avg_total FROM player_totals) SELECT SUM(total) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(total - avg_total) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE total > avg_total
